packages.name: Reclaim
packages.notes:
0.1.1-1576
- Add AI/CLI support through synopkgland ctl reclaim: authorization, volumes, jobs, scan status/results, history, overview, top paths, inspection, simulation, recycle bins, snapshots, system partition reports and cache status.
- Start a bounded scan job with explicit write confirmation; cleanup and permanent deletion are not exposed.
- Private inputs are masked with writeOnly; command responses return fixed fields. Uses SDK/App/CLI/templates 0.15.0 and UI 0.11.4; no new approval is needed when upgrading from 1574 or 1575.
- A cold system-partition report may exceed the CLI 10-second request deadline.

packages.name: Connect
packages.notes:
0.1.0-0056
- Adds AI and CLI operations through synopkgland ctl (alias: connect): status, connection status, ports list, ipv6 status and connection disconnect.
- Commands retain DSM administrator-only access. Disconnect requires confirmation; connection output excludes login links, device codes and private URLs.
- Updates SDK, CLI and templates to 0.15.0. No new root privileges or administrator reapproval.

packages.name: Download Hub
packages.notes:
0.2.2-0043
- Added AI and CLI operation through synopkgland ctl 0.15.0, under the gopeed alias.
- Commands cover task list/pause/resume, destination lookup, link and torrent submission, preparation status, search and result downloads.
- Keeps DSM App Privileges, per-user ownership and destination grants; sensitive URL/torrent/query inputs use standard writeOnly masking.
- Waiting for a submission confirms source preparation, not download/save completion. Existing executor approval is retained.
